title: General class and unit group engine
objective: Implement the deterministic small-field class-and-unit vertical slice and adaptive Buchmann-Hecke orchestration, including unconditional motivating quintic C4

handoff.summary: Hardened the ordinary-Python Buchmann-Hecke engine with per-phase timing, bounded resource diagnostics, structured progress, inner-loop cancellation polls, durable checkpoint save/resume hooks, deterministic single-prime and targeted ideal-product LLL scheduling, and a bounded exact one-large-prime partial pool. Relation termination now additionally measures the archimedean rank of exact dependency units and continues deterministically until it reaches the Dirichlet rank; restored searches resume their global ideal-attempt counter. The motivating proof=False quintic now completes with class group C4, logarithmic unit rank 2/2, 19 relations, and rigorous analytic index one. Focused tests cover 13 orchestration, exact partial, checkpoint, progress, resource, adaptive-unit-rank, routing, and C4-map cases.
risks: The motivating proof=False run completed in 111 seconds on this non-benchmark host, versus a prior 44-second incomplete receipt. Stable performance comparison and proof=True timing still belong on bench-1.

The checkpoint serializes authenticated factor bases, full relations, PRNG search state, and presentations, but intentionally does not serialize unmatched one-large-prime partials; resumption may repeat acceleration work without affecting correctness or determinism of admitted records.
pnpm test:native, pnpm test:changed, external Sage/PARI and Magma regeneration, and cross-platform receipts remain central integration gates.
next_steps: Merge the adaptive logarithmic-rank fix, then run the bench-1 quintic runner first with proof=False and then proof=True under its hard timeout; retain the emitted phase/search/resource diagnostics.
Run pnpm test:changed and pnpm test:native on the integrated native build, plus external Sage/PARI and Magma oracle regeneration for the quintic C4 target.
Move the contract to review only after the bench-1 and broad native gates are recorded.
